mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses the discount rate applied to equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This relationship holds as a continuous trend without regime dependence.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS predicting 20-day SPX returns is negative or below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.0% signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong labor market growth (PAYEMS above 150 thousand jobs) and declining unemployment (UNRATE below 3.6%) indicates a robust economic expansion that supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS > 150 and UNRATE < 3.6, or the Rank IC for the interaction term (PAYEMS * UNRATE) falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle economic expansions, strong housing starts (HOUST above 1400 thousand units) and robust retail sales (RSAFS above 700 million dollars) signal sustained consumer demand and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances during late-cycle expansions when HOUST > 1400 and RSAFS > 700, or the Rank IC for the joint condition falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1400 thousand units signals weakening consumer demand and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1400, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A lower unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a tight labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for UNRATE predicting 60-day SPX returns is negative or below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI reading above 300 (annualized inflation rate exceeding 6.5%) signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 300, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing and services activity, supporting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for INDPRO predicting 60-day SPX returns is negative or below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
